record.question: Identify the part of speech of the italicized word 'over' in: Hearing the news, I am over the moon.
record.explanation: Answer B: Preposition. The italicized word is 'over', not the whole idiom. It introduces the noun phrase 'the moon', so it is a preposition. Independently reviewed solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
